visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black t-shirt stands in a modern, brightly lit kitchen with white cabinets. He smiles enthusiastically, raising both hands to give a double thumbs-up gesture. A large glass bowl sits in the sink behind him. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a white water purification unit installed under a sink cabinet. Blue LED indicators are lit on its front panel next to a metallic container. (3) A clear glass of water is shown suspended in mid-air within the dark under-sink compartment, illuminated by a futuristic blue light from within the device area. (4) A hand holds a wine glass under a sleek, black touch-activated faucet. Clean water flows smoothly from the tap into the glass. (5) Five young adults—three men and two women—gather in the kitchen. They hold wine glasses filled with water, smiling and clinking them together in a celebratory toast. (6) A bright white screen transition occurs. (7) The group is shown again in a tighter shot, laughing and enjoying their drinks. (8) The main man in the black t-shirt is seen drinking water directly from a massive, fishbowl-like glass bowl, tilting his head back to finish the large volume. (9) A visual effect shows water spiraling upwards from the sink drain or faucet in a glowing, blue, magical-looking stream. (10) The man holds a small glass of water and uses his smartphone to take a close-up photo of it, illuminated by a spotlight. (11) He quickly downs the contents of a small wine glass, looking refreshed. (12) A montage of short clips shows the group interacting playfully while holding their water glasses around the sink area. (13) The video concludes with a product shot of the white under-sink unit and the black faucet installed in the kitchen.
